sections.chapter_title: Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)
sections.text_helper: Section 7.4.7 "Managing illegal accesses" in chapter 7 (Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 264.
sections.section_content:
As a RIF component, the RISAF does not use the standard interrupt lines toward NVIC or
GIC concentrators. The IAC captures all RIF interrupt events, called illegal access events.
Refer to Section8: Illegal access controller (IAC) for more information on how illegal
accesses are managed.
